newsitem.title: USA: Lawrence consents to AMEX delisting.
newsitem.headline: Lawrence consents to AMEX delisting.

text.p: Lawrence Insurance Group Inc on Friday said it has consented to the removal of its common stock from the American Stock Exchange.
Trading of the stock was halted on March 4, 1997.
The firm no longer satisfies financial guidelines of the AMEX for continued listing. The company said it expects to develop a market for its common stock over-the-counter.

The firm also said that as a result of the February 1997 bankruptcy filing of Lawrence's parent firm, Lawrence Group Inc, the Texas Department of Insurance has placed a Lawrence unit in conservatorship.
Neal Rockhold of TDI has been appointed conservator of Lawrence's United Republic Insurance Co, with the firm's consent.
